title: Costly Colours
combo.fourInColourTwoSuit: Four in colour, two in suit (4)
combo.fourInColourThreeSuit: Four in colour, three in suit (5)
restrictedTooltip: This would take the count past 31

hint.thirty_one: hits thirty-one exactly and closes the count
hint.safe: leaves your opponent little to peg

hint.mog_refuse: you already hold a colour - refuse and give up 1

tutorial.count: The count scores at **15, 25 and 31** - **the 25 has no counterpart in Cribbage**. Each pays one per constituent card, and **no card may take the count past 31**. A prial (three alike) scores **9** and a double prial **18**.
tutorial.scores: The show counts **your three cards plus the turn-up**. It is a **ladder of colours**: three in colour 2, three in suit 3, four in colour 4-5, and **four in suit 6 - "Costly Colours"**. Alongside it, a **Jack or Deuce of the turned suit pegs 4, any other 2**.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. **Cards that would pass 31 cannot be picked.** Jacks and deuces score just for being held, so mind the order you spend them.
tutorial.playButton: Each deal opens with the **mog** - the exchange. **Refusing pegs 1 for your opponent**, so it is only worth it when you already hold a colour.
tutorial.resetButton: The reset button starts a new game.
